title: Open Problems on Spectral-Parameter Yang–Baxter Solutions
exact_target: Develop a common theory of spectral-parameter Yang--Baxter families and relate their analytic behavior to braided or quasi-braided categories.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006484 (OWR-14299580-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: The Yang–Baxter Equation and Representations of Braid Groups (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/49, pp. 2633--2672. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: For infinite-dimensional $V$, domains and the topology of invertibility must be specified. Different checked and unchecked $R$ conventions give different written equations, so the report's convention is retained.
